name: Dusknoir

abilities.name: Fade into Darkness
abilities.text: When this Pokémon is Knocked Out, flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can’t get any points for it.

flavor:
With the mouth on its belly, Dusknoir swallows its
target whole. The soul is the only thing eaten—
Dusknoir disgorges the body before departing.

pokedex.text: NO. 0477 Gripper Pokémon HT: 7'3" WT: 235 lbs.
